title: The Tide of Rosewater Lane
author: Juniper Vane
blurb: Felix Marchetti, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
